name: Applegate Naturals Oven Roasted Turkey Breast (Deli Slices)
whyItWorks: Contains just 4 simple ingredients: turkey breast, water, sea salt, and potato starch. Free of carrageenan, chemical nitrates/nitrites, casein, and gluten. Clean, tender protein for sandwiches.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer onto soft white sourdough bread or eat rolled with a slice of Swiss cheese.
